B_prime.Rd

dB/dE, Eq. (43): strictly negative, hence s''(B) < 0, Eq. (44).

Usage

B_prime(E, a, s, beta0 = 1, omega = NULL)

Arguments

E

Energy: a nonnegative scalar or numeric vector.

a

Numeric vector of per-level shape parameters (a_1, ..., a_N); length is the cascade depth N (empty for N = 0).

s

Universality class: 0.5 (gamma / stretched-exponential) or 1 (inverse-gamma / power-law).

beta0

Inverse base temperature, 1/T0.

omega

Optional override for omega = prod(a_i), decoupled from a (needed by B_tilde's shifted vector).

Value

See details.
